name: manage_skill
description:
Author skills: action=create/update opens a draft, publish releases it, delete removes it, list_drafts lists drafts.
Only edit the returned draft (with apply_patch), then publish validates and atomically releases it. Creating a draft never overwrites an existing skill; publishing an update draft fails if the live skill changed in the meantime. Drafts unmodified for 30 days are cleaned up before list_drafts. Scripts inside a skill remain resources and are not registered as tools.

description.description: action=create: what the skill does and when it should be used.

scope.description: global is available to all personas; persona only to the current persona. Required for update/delete; create defaults to global.

draft_id.description: action=publish: draft ID returned by create or update.
